frontend.notes: Single-page static UI (index.html + app.js + styles.css) served by the backend; no build step, no framework.

backend.notes: Python 3.10+ standard library only (http.server + sqlite3). Serves src/ui/ and /api/* on one port and enforces the spec §3.3 state table server-side.

database.notes: File database created from src/db/schema.sql on first start (src/backend/data/licensing.db); demo seed data loaded when the file is created.

regulations: Commercial Business Licensing Policy (CBL-101) — sections 4, 6 and 9a as provided in resources/policies_and_policies

capabilityGroups.name: Buyer Self-Service Intake & Surety Bond Portal
Licensing Operations Adjudication, Registry & Card Issuance
